Field report, survey team B. The first camp was set at 34.0522 N, 118.2437 W near the river on 2024-03-15.
The second camp (40 26 46 N 79 58 56 W) followed on March 21, 2024, with a resupply at N51.5074 W0.1278.
Grid references from the map sheet: 18SUJ2348306479 and 18S UJ 234 064; the coarse square 4QFJ1234 was also noted.
A UTM fix reads 17N 630084 4833438, and another 56H 334786 6252080 was relayed on 3/18/2024.
Degrees and minutes: 40 26.767 N 79 58.933 W, packed 4026.77N 07958.93W, and 402646N 0795856W.
